en.hubeali: H 14817 – A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Al-Hassan Bin Ali Bin Usman who said: Abu Abdullah Al-Mada’iny narrated from Abu Abdullahasws having said that:

‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Created a star in the seventh orbit. So he<sup>azwj</sup> Created it from cold water and the rest of the six stars flowed from hot water, and it is the star of the Prophets<sup>as</sup>, and the successors<sup>asws</sup> and it is the star of Amir-ul-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> commanding the exit from the world, and the ascetism in it, and commanding for the dust to be the mattress, and bricks to rest upon (for a pillow), and coarse clothing, and eating the tasteless (food), and Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has not Created a star more closer to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the High, than it’.
en.sarwar: 370. A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Al-Hassan Bin Ali Bin Usman who said: Abu Abdullah Al-Mada’iny narrated from Abu Abdullah (a.s.) having said that:

‘Allah (azwj) Created a star in the seventh orbit. So he (azwj) Created it from cold water and the rest of the six stars flowed from hot water, and it is the star of the Prophets (as), and the successors (a.s.) and it is the star of Amir-ul-Momineen (a.s.) commanding the exit from the world, and the ascetism in it, and commanding for the dust to be the mattress, and bricks to rest upon (for a pillow), and coarse clothing, and eating the tasteless (food), and Allah (azwj) has not Created a star more closer to Allah (azwj) the High, than it’.
